MethodologieText: I organize my revisions by alternating between visual and auditory supports. Managed by the Anki algorithm, which is based on Ebbinghaus' forgetting curve, active learning combined with spaced repetition allows me to retain complex concepts such as technical vocabulary and strengthens my ability to communicate them.
interfaceText: I am certain that a well-designed interface is as important as a performant resource. In my projects, I pay attention to the user's experience so that they can understand the functioning without getting lost.
disciplineText: Curious to discover new cultures and ways of thinking, I enjoy learning new languages with such regularity that I have achieved a streak exceeding 1000 days on Duolingo. Every year, I meet with students in my school's language exchange program to help them integrate. Thus, I have been able to improve my communication skills and flourish in worlds of infinite creativity on the internet.
intro: Versatile digital creator, I combine web development with intuitive UX design and narrative audiovisual experience
snakeGoal: Creation of an interactive Snake game playable on browser, revisited with an artistic direction around the desert and the different game modes.
snakeChallenge: During the algorithmic development of this game, I faced the problem of simulating the continuous movement of an entity in a grid managed by two arrays (X and Y), without overloading the browser's memory.
snakeSolution: I add the new position values of the snake's head in the arrays using unshift, and simultaneously remove the last data of the tail with pop. Thus, the snake moves smoothly and optimized.
snakeImpact: Developing this game allowed me to acquire a better understanding of array manipulation in JavaScript to optimize the rendering of a time loop.
portfolioGoal: Designing a Single Page Application to demonstrate my front-end architecture and UI/UX design skills to support my future applications.
portfolioChallenge: Beyond faithfully reproducing my Figma mockup, I set two constraints: ensuring smooth navigation without page reloads and the ability to easily add future projects.
portfolioImpact: Thus, the visitor gets a smooth and uniform navigation experience. Additionally, maintaining this site is simplified as I can quickly add and modify projects without creating new files.
portfolioSolution: I then centralized my project data in a single file, mapped them to display them in the same way on pages automatically created using React Router. To make this more robust, I used conditional rendering on data that might not be used.
akashaGoal: Creating a web application to track progress in reading and watching, featuring a diverse search engine and an intuitive, pleasant interface.
akashaChallenge: This application category is primarily focused on the search function, which must minimize user friction and provide relevant results quickly. However, Akasha relies on 4 distinct APIs, in addition to its own database fed by users' custom contributions. Poor implementation would lead to data inconsistencies and prolonged, or unsuccessful, searches.
akashaSolution: I designed a MediaItem interface in TypeScript to normalize incoming API streams. To reduce wait times, the search engine executes each API in parallel using the asynchronous Promise.allSettled function, which also tolerates failures. Upon receiving the data, it is correctly associated with the MediaItem through a complete, API-specific mapping system.
akashaImpact: The user thus benefits from a smooth and consistent experience, never being disrupted by the failure of any of the sources. On the architecture side, this normalization ensures simplified maintenance and evolvable code: it is now possible to integrate new APIs without having to modify the overall logic of the interface.
